t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Tall hats generally give the best results. Avoid the red and brown ones. Consider changing your choices for a few rounds if points are low.

vb_textbox.text: I found that gnomes on the left tended to give better amounts of mushrooms although I varied it for extended amounts of time to test my theory. Sometimes the red and brown gnomes will tall hats gave lower amounts than the other gnomes.
